implementationScope: Local offline contract adapter only; no live analytics, advertising, push or CMP SDK is connected.
fixed: First-launch test flag now overrides automatic XCTest host bypass.
Cancelled permission tasks no longer claim successful completion; the saved acceptance can resume pending steps.
An accepted-version file without an acceptance timestamp is no longer trusted.
Analytics remains disabled until consent; unknown events/fields, incomplete required fields, invalid enums and negative counters are rejected.
String IDs remain strings even when they contain only digits; integer and boolean fields use their declared types.
Failed writes remain queued in memory with original identifiers and timestamps and retry after storage recovers.
Active session state is persisted, permitting a single interrupted-session end on next launch.
Short background transitions reuse the session; a longer break creates a new session and excludes background time from active duration.
Corrupt primary analytics queue is preserved and the previous valid backup is attempted.
Default Keychain identity namespace distinguishes normal, UI-test and app-test storage directories.
pendingReferenceDecisions: Actual project session timeout is absent. The injectable local-demo default is 300 seconds and is not a frozen Pawdoku value.

Original table says session_end on background while session_start is new only after background timeout. This adapter persists a pending end at the background timestamp and finalizes it on a long resume or cold start; exact platform reconciliation needs freezing.

Original requires one level_end per attempt but also supports unlimited same-board revives. A failed attempt later revived to victory needs a frozen analytics rule: update the single result or start a new attempt. Current app preserves attempt and first terminal result.
Interstitial placement_id is not listed in the section 6.3 placement enum despite section 8.6 adding interstitial ad_type. A formal placement enum must be supplied before live analytics.

Publisher Terms/Privacy documents, regional CMP implementation, SDK credentials/environment IDs and reinstall identity policy have not been supplied. Local legal pages are explicitly internal-demo notices.
Raw SDK impression-start callback must drive ad_result started for a live adapter; the current rewarded adapter is a simulation.
Network transport, acknowledgment, revenue and production dashboards are not verified by these local tests.
